def power(a, b):
    return pow(a, b, MOD)

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    if k == 0:
        exponent = p - 1
    elif k == 1:
        exponent = p
    else:
        ord = 1
        cur = k
        while cur != 1:
            cur = (cur * k) % p
            ord += 1
        exponent = (p - 1) // ord
    print(power(p, exponent))
